title: Fully Byzantine-Resilient Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.25701v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study distributed Byzantine-resilient actor-critic multi-agent reinforcement learning (AC-MARL), where agents collectively learn policies through local interactions. Existing methods guarantee convergence of the agents' parameters only to a neighborhood of the attack-free limit points, resulting in degraded performance. We propose Fully Resilient AC-MARL (FRAC-MARL), a decentralized method in which each agent leverages redundancy in two-hop messages to identify reliable messages. Under linear parameterizations of the value and team-reward functions and Byzantine edge attacks, where adversarial behavior is confined to the communication layer, we prove that agents' parameters converge almost surely to the same limit points as in the attack-free case over time-varying communication graphs. translated_title: 完全拜占庭容错的多智能体强化学习
translated_abstract: 我们研究了分布式拜占庭容错的演员-评论家多智能体强化学习（AC-MARL），其中智能体通过本地交互共同学习策略。现有方法只能保证智能体的参数收敛到无攻击极限点的邻域内，从而导致性能下降。我们提出了完全弹性AC-MARL（FRAC-MARL），这是一种去中心化方法，每个智能体利用两跳消息中的冗余来识别可靠消息。在价值函数和团队奖励函数的线性参数化以及拜占庭边攻击（对抗行为仅限于通信层）的条件下，我们证明智能体的参数几乎必然收敛到与时变通信图上无攻击情况相同的极限点。我们为该方法的收敛性引入了一种新颖的拓扑条件，提出了一种构建此类网络的系统性方法，并证明…
tldr: 提出FRAC-MARL去中心化方法，通过利用两跳消息冗余识别可靠消息，使拜占庭攻击下的多智能体强化学习智能体参数几乎必然收敛到与无攻击情况相同的极限点。
en_tdlr: FRAC-MARL, a decentralized method that leverages two-hop message redundancy to identify reliable messages, enables agents' parameters in Byzantine-resilient multi-agent reinforcement learning to converge almost surely to the same limit points as in the attack-free case.
